description: Registry of all 11 consultant findings with strict acceptance conditions. A finding is FIXED only if EVERY required condition passes. Missing evidence = UNRESOLVED, never FIXED.

findings.finding: P-16 regulatory pathway — no Class III/510(k) contradiction
findings.consultant_assertion: P-16 must not contain mutually contradictory regulatory pathways (e.g., Class III PMA AND 510(k) simultaneously)
required_evidence: no contradictory pathway present in same package
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL: device_class present AND regulatory_pathway present AND no contradiction between them
findings.disqualifying_condition: ANY: device_class missing OR pathway missing OR contradictory pathways found (e.g., PMA + 510(k) in same package)

findings.finding: P-01 falsification — documented repair pathway exists or package is downgraded
findings.consultant_assertion: The falsified dual-invariant must have a structured repair record, not just a keyword mention
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL 7 fields present in a structured repair record. A keyword like 'graceful degradation' is NOT sufficient.
findings.disqualifying_condition: ANY of the 7 fields missing OR repair is only acknowledged via keyword without structured record

findings.finding: P-04 '100% clearance' — clearly MODELLED/ideal-condition statement everywhere
findings.consultant_assertion: The '100% clearance' claim must be explicitly labelled MODELLED in every place it appears
required_evidence: R370 claims evidence_class is MODEL_PREDICTED or HYPOTHESIS (not PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED)
no instance of '100% clearance' without MODELLED qualifier
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL: modelled_only has 100%+MODELLED AND R370 evidence_class is MODEL_PREDICTED AND no unqualified '100% clearance'
findings.disqualifying_condition: ANY: 100% appears without MODELLED OR evidence_class is PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED

findings.finding: P-13 buyer data dependency — buyer and dataset partner are explicit
findings.consultant_assertion: A named data partner with dataset type, relevance, and access status must be explicit — not just a keyword 'data'
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL 6 fields present. A phrase containing 'data' is NOT sufficient.
findings.disqualifying_condition: ANY of the 6 fields missing OR only keyword 'data' present without structured partner record

findings.consultant_assertion: SAR (Specific Absorption Rate) must have an explicit status field, not inferred from 'regulatory pathway unknown'
required_evidence: explicit SAR_STATUS field with value ASSESSED, UNKNOWN, or NOT_ASSESSED
SAR is explicitly mentioned by name (not just 'regulatory pathway')
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL: SAR explicitly named AND SAR_STATUS field present with explicit value
findings.disqualifying_condition: SAR not explicitly named OR SAR_STATUS inferred from generic 'regulatory pathway unknown'

findings.finding: P-22-R1 four control problems — all four explicitly documented with resolution paths
findings.consultant_assertion: All four control problems (buckling, control stability, tissue safety, failure recovery) must be documented with resolution paths. 3/4 is NOT sufficient.
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL 4 problems documented (4/4, not >=3) with each having problem+evidence+resolution_path
findings.disqualifying_condition: ANY of the 4 problems missing OR missing resolution_path for any problem

findings.finding: P-24 protocol — complete step-by-step experiment, not merely hypothesis/cost/threshold
findings.consultant_assertion: P-24 must have a complete step-by-step experiment protocol
required_evidence: protocol field is present and not UNKNOWN
protocol contains step-by-step procedure (not just hypothesis/cost/threshold)
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL: protocol present AND not UNKNOWN AND step-by-step AND sample_size+measurement+variables+control present
findings.disqualifying_condition: protocol is UNKNOWN OR missing OR only hypothesis/cost/threshold without steps

findings.consultant_assertion: P-28 must have a complete step-by-step experiment protocol
required_evidence: protocol field is present and not UNKNOWN
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL: protocol present AND not UNKNOWN AND step-by-step

findings.finding: P-28 prior-art proximity to ShuntCheck — explicitly mapped
findings.consultant_assertion: P-28's relationship to ShuntCheck (US20130109998A1) must be explicitly mapped
required_evidence: ShuntCheck or US20130109998 explicitly named in a regulatory or patent field
predicate_candidate or prior_art field references ShuntCheck
pathway_hypothesis mentions ShuntCheck or similar predicate
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL: ShuntCheck explicitly named AND predicate_candidate references it AND pathway_hypothesis mentions it
findings.disqualifying_condition: ShuntCheck not found OR only generic prior-art mention without specific reference

findings.finding: Ownership/IP/Section 39 — clearly marked as unresolved/counsel-required, never represented as legal clearance
findings.consultant_assertion: Ownership must be explicitly marked as unresolved/counsel-required for every package
required_evidence: every package has Ownership in material_unknowns
ownership unknown states 'No IP assignment verified' or equivalent
no package represents ownership as legal clearance or FTO
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL 15 packages have Ownership UNKNOWN AND none represent legal clearance
findings.disqualifying_condition: ANY package missing Ownership unknown OR any package claims legal clearance/FTO

findings.finding: P-25 and killed assets — must not appear in buyer-facing portfolio
findings.consultant_assertion: Killed packages must not appear in any active buyer-facing artifact
required_evidence: P-25 not in R370 buyer maps
all killed packages (P-03, P-05, P-06, P-08, P-09, P-10, P-12, P-14, P-17, P-19, P-20, P-23, P-25) not in active artifacts
findings.acceptance_condition: ALL killed packages absent from ALL active R370 artifacts (axes, claims, buyers)
findings.disqualifying_condition: ANY killed package found in ANY active artifact
